צה.ja: אלי גירהם קד סלבת ענהם, ומא חצל להם מנהא אפאת חלת בהם, פלא יעקלון ען אללה אלמנעם בהא עליהם, כקול אלולי ע"ס רשע בגובה אפו בל ידרש אין אלהים כל מזימותיו.
צה.en: as if it had been wrested from themselves, and what has accrued to them out of it as injuries that have struck them. They do not bring God to mind — the One who bestowed it upon them — like the saying of the Friend (peace be upon him): "The wicked man in his pride does not seek; 'There is no God' is the whole of his scheming" (Psalms 10:4).

pairs.en: from themselves
as if it had been wrested
and what has accrued to them out of it

צה.ja: ואלכ'לה אלת'אניה כ'רוג'הם אלי הד'א אלעאלם והם פי חאל אלבהאים ג'הלא ועיא, כקול אלחכים ועיר פרא אדם יולד.
צה.en: The second obstacle is their emerging into this world while in the state of brutes — ignorant and unseeing — as the Wise One said: "Like a wild ass colt is man born" (Job 11:12).

צה.ja: ונשווהם פי נעם אללה אלסאבגה, ותרדדהם פיהא חתי תציר ענדהם מעהודה מאלופה כאנהא ד'אתיה להם לא תזאילהם ולא תפארקהם טול מדהֵ אעמארהם,
צה.en: And their growing up amid the prior blessings of God and being constantly bound up with them, until those blessings become for them familiar and customary, as if they were essential to them — not separable from them, not parting from them all the length of their lives.

צה.ja: פאד'א עקלוא וקוי תמייזהם ג'הלוא וג'ה אלנעמה עליהם, ולם ילזמוא קלובהם אלשכר ללה ענהא ג'הלא בקדר אלנעמה ואלמנעם בהא עליהם.
צה.en: So when they come to reason, and their discernment grows strong, they remain ignorant of the aspect of the blessing upon them, and do not bind their hearts to thank God for it, out of ignorance of the worth of the blessing and of the One who has bestowed it upon them.

pairs.en: So when they come to reason

pairs.ja: ולם ילזמוא קלובהם אלשכר ללה ענהא

צה.ja: ומת'להם פי ד'לך כרג'ל מן אהל אלפצ'ל אלפי טפלא פי פלאה מן אלארץ' פשפק עליה, פצ'מה אלי ביתה ורבאה ואטעמה וכסאה וג'אד עליה בג'מיע מצאלחה אלי אן עקל ופהם וג'וה רשדה.
צה.en: Their case in this is like the case of a man of generosity who found an abandoned infant in a wasteland of the earth, and took pity on him, and brought him into his house, and raised him and fed him and clothed him and was lavish with him in every aspect of his welfare, until the child came to reason and understand the modes of his upbringing.

pairs.ja: אלי אן עקל ופהם וג'וה רשדה
pairs.en: until the child came to reason and understand the modes of his upbringing

צה.ja: ת'ם אן אלרג'ל סמע ען אסיר פי יד עדוה קד בלג בה אלי גאיה מן אלשקא ואלג'וע ואלערי מדה טוילה, פרק לחאלה, ולם יזל ילטף בעדוה חתי אטלקה ווהבה ת'מנה,
צה.en: Then this man heard of a captive in the hand of his enemy, who had reached an extreme of misery and hunger and nakedness over a long stretch of time — so he had compassion on his condition, and did not cease to manage matters gently with his enemy until he released him, and ransomed him at his price.

pairs.en: Then this man heard
of a captive in the hand of his enemy

pairs.ja: קד בלג בה אלי גאיה מן אלשקא
pairs.en: who had reached an extreme of misery

צה.ja: פצ'מה בעד ד'לך אלי מנזלה ואחסן אליה וג'אד עליה בבעץ' מא ג'אד בה עלי אלטפל,
צה.en: Then, after this, the man brought him into his house and treated him kindly and was lavish with him in some part of what he had been lavish with upon the child.

pairs.en: Then, after this, the man brought him into his house

צה.ja: פכאן אלרג'ל אלאסיר אמיז ואשכר לנעמהֵ אלרג'ל עליה מן אלטפל אלד'י נשא ורבי פי נעמתה, לכ'רוג'ה מן חאל אלשקא אלי חאל אלתרוח ואלרפאהה פי חאל תמייזה,
צה.en: Then this captive man — once delivered — was more discerning and more grateful for the man's blessing upon him than the child who had been raised and brought up in his beneficence: because he had passed from the state of misery to the state of relief and ease in his moment of discernment,

pairs.en: Then this captive man

pairs.ja: מן אלטפל אלד'י נשא ורבי פי נעמתה

צה.ja: פהו כת'יר אלתמייז לאחסאן אלרג'ל אלפאצ'ל אליה ואנעאמה עליה,
צה.en: so that he was abundantly discerning of the kindness of the man of generosity to him and his bestowal of blessings upon him.

צה.ja: ואלטפל ג'אהל בקדר אלנעמה עליה ואן קוי תמייזה ות'בת עקלה, לאלפתה להא מנד' חאל צבאיה.
צה.en: The child, by contrast, was ignorant of the worth of the blessing upon him — even when his discernment grew strong and his reason was established — on account of his familiarity with it from the time of his infancy.

צה.en: And not one of those possessed of reason doubts that his generosity and his blessing upon the child
